crossRefs.note: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
translations.asv: and Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.
